BLightInterestError.description: A bounded creator-gated Interest error, optionally carrying authoritative Interest state and a typed recovery focus.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a rate-limited activation may be retried.

BLightPlanError.description: A bounded creator-gated Plan error, optionally carrying authoritative Commitment state and exact Plan recovery focus.

RateLimited.description: The request exceeded a server-side rate limit.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page, or null when this collection is exhausted.

realtimeCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the matching SSE endpoint.
Opaque cursor for the matching SSE endpoint.

ChatRealtimeEventData.description: JSON encoded in each SSE data field. STREAM_RESET requires a fresh history request before reconnecting.

filename.description: Year-specific filename for the selected annual export.

subscriptionUrl.description: Private bearer URL returned only when the connection is created. Do not log or persist it in plaintext.

repeatUntil.description: Optional ISO 8601 boundary. Omit or send an empty string for a recurring series without an end.

count.description: Number of logical events created. A recurring series is one logical event.

DiscoverActionCoordination.description: Capability-aware interaction semantics for this immutable Action policy. Mutations still repeat authoritative eligibility checks.

city.description: Canonical Discover city echoed for this feed.

DiscoverBuddyPostUpdateRequest.description: Complete editable state for an existing Discover buddy post. Unlike create, update does not accept category changes and requires the current city and audience settings.

city.description: The post's current canonical Discover city. It must match the existing post because editing cannot move a post between cities.
Canonical Discover city from /api/v1/client-config. When omitted by an older client, the server uses its current default city.

coordinationPolicy.description: Trusted source Action policy. Null when the Plan has no surviving Action source; clients must not infer policy from stable Plan IDs.

availabilityStartMinutes.description: Start of the owner's explicitly shareable daily availability in Europe/Berlin minutes after midnight. Omitted on legacy links.

availabilityEndMinutes.description: Exclusive end of the owner's explicitly shareable daily availability in Europe/Berlin minutes after midnight. Omitted on legacy links.
